source_text: Quattuor hic personarum causa vertitur: Dei opificis, duorum parentum de quibus materia praestatur operanti, et parvuli qui nascitur. Dicis tu in hoc choro habitare peccatum; interrogo ego, a quo fiat, utrum a Deo? Negas: A patre? Totidem negas: A matre? Idem negas: A parvulo? Negas; et adhuc non putas fuisse conclusum, quia non possit esse inter hos quattuor, quod ab his quattuor nullus admittit?
pass_a_gloss: Here the cause of four persons is being turned: of God the craftsman, of the two parents from whom material is furnished to the one working, and of the little child who is born. You say that sin dwells in this chorus; I ask by whom it is done, whether by God? You deny: By the father? You deny equally: By the mother? You deny the same: By the little child? You deny; and still you do not think it has been concluded, because that cannot be among these four which none of these four admits?

lemmas.lexica: LS peccatum=fault, error; Blaise Christian sin
LS parvulus; Blaise infants in original-sin debate

pass_b_english: The case here concerns four persons: God the maker; the two parents, from whom the material is supplied to the maker; and the infant who is born. You say sin dwells in this company. I ask who commits it. God? You say no. The father? Again you say no. The mother? The same answer. The infant? No. And you still do not think it has been proved that something none of these four commits cannot exist among these four?

choices.why: Parents insofar as parents are not guilty; keep the forensic 'in quantum parentes sunt'.
Julian's forensic/moral fault tied to will, not a substance in nature.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
